articles.summary: HeyReach is a solid LinkedIn-only sequencer. Most teams outgrow LinkedIn-only as soon as they need email, calls, or separate client workspaces. Here's where it breaks.
articles.title: Verbiflow vs HeyReach: when one-channel LinkedIn breaks down

articles.summary: Every growth team has the same five-tool outbound stack glued together by Zaps. Each tool works fine on its own. The trouble starts when one campaign has to run across all of them and nothing shares state.
articles.title: Outbound is an infrastructure problem, not a tool problem
